labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: saver cannot write campaigns
labels.value: Campaign sync skipped {0} appeal(s): the person who saved them cannot create and edit Campaigns, or does not have the Campaign Sync permission set. Click Sync all appeals on the Campaign sync page to catch them up.

labels.shortDescription: Appeal save refused: Campaign ID is not one
labels.value: Campaign ID must be the record ID of a Campaign (18 characters, starting 701), or empty.
